masterSpecification.document: PANIN - Kshetra - AI Agent Master Execution Document and Sequential Job Book.md
tasks: Replace false success with explicit: FAILED, QUEUED, SYNCING, SYNCED.
evidenceStandard: No successful persistence claim when server persistence failed.

findings.description: Generates synthetic IDs (local-${Date.now()}, poll-local-..., opt-local-...) that are passed to store and never updated when server returns authoritative UUIDs.
findings.impact: Leaves posts permanently in store with local- IDs, causing feed filtering logic (localOnly) to treat them as local-only permanently.

findings.description: Generates synthetic ID local-c-${Date.now()} for new comments that is never reconciled with server-returned comment UUID.
findings.impact: Subsequent actions on this comment (deletions, reactions) fail or operate on non-existent database identifiers.

findings.description: submitEvidence generates synthetic ID pe-${Date.now()} and stores in local state only; toggleFollowPromise toggles local state only. Neither calls backend or dataService.
findings.impact: User evidence submissions and promise follows are completely lost on app refresh / multi-device; zero server persistence.

findings.description: addShort generates short-user-${Date.now()} and writes solely to MMKV; approveShort and flagShort mutate local MMKV state only without calling DataService.
findings.impact: Citizen shorts uploads and community moderation approvals/flags are isolated to local device with zero backend propagation.

findings.description: Module progress and challenges are mutated exclusively in local Zustand/MMKV state; corresponding dataService methods are never invoked.
findings.impact: Leadership academy progress exists only in client storage; not synchronized with aspirant database profile.

findings.description: SyncOpType defines add_comment, but executeOp omits case 'add_comment' and falls through to default: return true.
findings.impact: Offline queued post comments are silently dropped while reporting false success.

findings.description: Calls enqueue('compose_post') (which executes composePost immediately if online) and then immediately calls dataService.composePost a second time.
findings.impact: Causes redundant duplicate post creation requests on online networks.

findings.description: Absence of the required 4-state lifecycle (FAILED, QUEUED, SYNCING, SYNCED) across all 29 mobile Zustand stores and offline queue models.
findings.impact: Violates primary Job 011 specification; optimistic writes are either assumed fully synced or silently discarded without user visibility.

findings.description: Catches database update failure, modifies inMemoryBooths array, and returns HTTP 200 { success: true, booth: inMemoryBooths[memIdx] }.
findings.impact: Falsely reports successful server persistence to client when PostgreSQL write failed.

findings.description: Generates synthetic ID v-${Date.now().toString(36)}, unshifts to inMemoryVolunteers, swallows DB insert error with empty catch, and returns HTTP 201 { success: true, volunteer }.
findings.impact: Cadre registrations appear successful to caller even when unpersisted in PostgreSQL.

findings.description: When !isSupabaseConfigured, generates synthetic ID pad-${Date.now()}, pushes to MEMORY_ADS, and returns HTTP 201 { success: true, ad }.
findings.impact: Falsely certifies political ad creation when database is completely disconnected.

findings.description: Returns synthetic ID mock-verif-${Date.now()} and HTTP 200 { success: true } when Supabase is unconfigured.
findings.impact: Falsely acknowledges citizen identity verification submission without persistence.

findings.description: Skips database mutation when !isSupabaseConfigured and returns HTTP 200 { success: true }.
findings.impact: Falsely confirms blocking/unblocking a user when no database record was modified.

findings.description: Injects mock user 'auth-token-user' for any Bearer token when !isSupabaseConfigured.
findings.impact: Permits unauthenticated requests to bypass authentication checks during database disconnection.

findings.description: Hardcodes fallback URL 'https://kshetra-api-production-9f06.up.railway.app' and uses raw ad-hoc fetch() with x-user-id header, bypassing canonical apiClient.
findings.impact: Direct message operations bypass apiClient token handling, deadline budgets, and staging environment isolation.

findings.description: All 29 deceptive return true cases were eliminated in W010 Batch L3 and now fail-closed honestly.
findings.impact: Zero deceptive return true cases remain in DataService.

findings.description: All 6 synthetic ID cases in DataService were eliminated in W010 Batch L3, now returning { id: null, success: false }.
findings.impact: DataService no longer generates local-* IDs.

findings.description: Verified legitimate non-defect: return true occurs after confirmed PostgreSQL update; best-effort non-fatal RPC is safely isolated.
findings.impact: Not a defect.

findings.description: All civic routes enforce fail-closed 503 when !isSupabaseConfigured and 501 for unpersisted operations (Operations 8 & 10).
findings.impact: Verified fail-closed in W009-B4.

findings.description: Enforces fail-closed 503 when !isSupabaseConfigured; orders persist atomically via Migration 035.
findings.impact: Verified in W008-E and W009-B5.

findings.description: Prepaid wallet and campaign recharge orders use durable PostgreSQL tables with fail-closed signature verification.
findings.impact: Verified in W008-E and W009-B2.

findings.description: scheduleLocalNotification wrapped in catch; returns true because in-app inbox notification was persisted.
findings.impact: Safe degraded UX: in-app notification delivered even if device OS notification permission denied.

findings.description: Iterates through candidate LLM models on API rate limit or error.
findings.impact: Standard resilient model fallback.

findings.description: Test sandbox provider with strict anti-production guard throwing if process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'.
findings.impact: Accepted in W009-B2 and W009-B5 for CI/staging testing.

findings.description: Controlled diagnostic error generator locked behind x-debug-bypass-secret and returning 404 in production.
findings.impact: Accepted in W004-R1.

findings.description: Simulated telecom delivery percentages on client side; scheduled under Master Jobs W025–W029 (Campaign / Broadcast).
findings.impact: Does not block core social/civic fallback repair.

findings.description: Scheduled under Master Jobs W013–W017.
findings.impact: Contamination guards active.

findings.description: Scheduled under Master Job W052.
findings.impact: Runtime boundary active.

findings.description: Returns { success: true, count: 0 } on database exception. Requires runtime probe to verify if mobile client requires 503 or degrades cleanly with { count: 0, status: 'unavailable' }.
findings.impact: May mask database outages or prevent unread badge errors.

findings.description: Returns MOCK_REPORTS_QUEUE when database query returns empty or unconfigured. Requires runtime probe to determine if admin panel relies on mock queue for empty states.
findings.impact: May present fabricated reports in production admin view.

proposedRemediationBatches.name: Mobile UI Synthetic ID Elimination & ID Reconciliation
scope: apps/mobile/components/ComposeSheet.tsx (generate RFC-4122 UUID v4 or client temp token, reconcile with server ID on submit)
apps/mobile/stores/promises.ts (wire submitEvidence & toggleFollow to DataService; eliminate pe-*)
apps/mobile/stores/politicalShorts.ts (wire addShort, approveShort, flagShort to DataService; eliminate short-user-*)
apps/mobile/stores/aspirant.ts (wire completeModule, startModule, joinChallenge to DataService)

proposedRemediationBatches.name: Canonical 4-State Synchronization Lifecycle (FAILED, QUEUED, SYNCING, SYNCED)
scope: apps/mobile/lib/offlineSync.ts (implement SyncStatus enum, fix add_comment switch case, eliminate double-execution)
apps/mobile/stores/feed.ts (add syncStatus: 'SYNCED' | 'QUEUED' | 'SYNCING' | 'FAILED' to posts and comments)
apps/mobile/stores/civic.ts (wire explicit syncStatus to issues and civic comments)

proposedRemediationBatches.name: Canonical API Client Routing & Direct-Calling Strangler Alignment (DEF-005)
scope: apps/mobile/lib/supabaseDataService.ts (migrate raw fetch DM calls to canonical apiClient)
apps/mobile/lib/supabaseDataService.ts:49 (align checkContentModeration client catch to explicit fail-closed policy)
